title: CNFINBENCH: A BENCHMARK FOR SAFETY AND COMPLIANCE OF LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS IN FINANCE
reasoning: The CNFinBench benchmark includes a core 'Safety' dimension comprising 'Safety Q&As' that specifically evaluate models on ethical standards and moral conduct. These tasks assess 'ethical alignment within financial service contexts' and 'Ethics & Morality Responsible Conduct,' requiring models to adhere to principles such as fairness and honesty while refusing to assist in ethically questionable activities like predatory lending.
